primary_rule: Use the earliest launched attempt of each assigned slot; retain later retries and cross-member supplemental attempts with costs. Separate all original smoke records irrespective of outcome. Mapping remains a proposal until M5/owner review; raw manifests are unchanged.
limitations: Scheduler key/run path and backups support intended repetition ownership, but no raw repetition field is rewritten.
A scheduler completed entry means the runner finished, not that task utility was true.
Unknown task outcomes or unknown failed-attempt usage remain unknown.
The existing frozen registrar does not load this mapping automatically.
